entities.name: Signs
entities.description: Regulations and standards related to signage in the city, including signage placement, size, and content to ensure safety, accessibility, and aesthetic consistency.

entities.name: Zoning Code
entities.description: Legal framework governing land use, building regulations, and spatial organization within the city to promote organized development and land utilization.

entities.name: Real Estate
entities.description: Activities, regulations, and market conditions related to buying, selling, leasing, and managing property within the city.

entities.name: Compliance Requirements
entities.description: Legal standards and regulations that entities must adhere to, including those set by the Department of Business Professional Regulation (DBPR) and other authorities, affecting various city operations.

entities.name: Impact on Commercial Real Estate
entities.description: Effects of regulations, signage, zoning, and other policies on the commercial real estate market, including leasing, development, and business location decisions.

entities.name: Walkability
entities.description: The measure of how friendly an area is to walking, including sidewalk quality, safety, signage, and proximity of amenities to promote pedestrian activity.

entities.name: Parking
entities.description: Regulations, availability, and management of parking facilities within the city to support transportation needs and urban mobility.
